title: Claims Manual — Excess Flood Policies (Surplus Lines) Claim Intake, Adjustment Reports and Proof of Loss
content:
Claims under an **Excess Flood Policies (Surplus Lines)** policy are taken and documented as follows.

## Covered claims

A claim is taken for direct physical loss by flood to the insured home. A claim is covered only when the date of loss falls on or after the excess effective date and before the cancellation effective date or the term end. The date of loss is the one the caller gives at first notice; the effective date, the term end and any cancellation effective date are read from the policy record.

## The file

The underlying claim number is recorded at first notice, and the adjuster contacts the insured within the tier's adjuster contact standard in elapsed hours. Every adjuster report measures the whole covered dwelling loss at the tier's dwelling settlement basis and the whole covered personal property loss at the tier's personal property settlement basis, from the first dollar, and the loss of use incurred; a FINAL report supersedes earlier ones and a later SUPPLEMENTAL report supersedes it for what it measures. The underlying carrier's payment letter or statement of loss is recorded as received.

## Proof of loss deadline

A proof of loss is accepted only when it is received no later than the tier's proof-of-loss period in calendar days after the date of loss, counted by adding the days to the date of loss on the calendar with the last day qualifying. The date of loss is the one on the claim file for that claim number.

Boundary cases (hypothetical dates, 60-day period): for a date of loss of 10 June the last qualifying day is 9 August; a proof of loss received on 9 August is accepted, and one received on 10 August is not.

## Payment timing

When the tier requires the underlying settlement, an excess dwelling or personal property payment is issued only after the underlying settlement is recorded; loss of use is not held for it.

> Retired clause: payment is due within the tier's claim-payment days after the later of the agreed proof of loss and the underlying settlement record.

This clause is **no longer in force** as written. It is superseded by the current basis: a loss-of-use payment is due as the current loss-of-use payment basis sets out; a building or personal property payment is due within the tier's claim-payment days after the later of the agreed proof of loss and the underlying settlement record.

superseded_clauses: Payment is due within claim_payment_days calendar days after the later of the agreed proof of loss and the underlying settlement record.
